verdict.rationale: Pylon's training-data docs say you can connect external knowledge sources that all its AI features consume. Its native knowledge base hosts support articles and internal runbooks, and Support Agents deflect questions using that content (pylon-docs-22, pylon-docs-59, pylon-docs-60, pylon-docs-13); connectors also let agents search outside tools for context. However, the evidence is generic: it never names which help centers, docs sites or wikis are supported, nor says that past tickets are used as a knowledge source rather than just available as issue context. Missing for 10: named source types (external help center, docs site, wikis such as Notion or Confluence), explicit ingestion of historical tickets, sync and refresh behavior that avoids re-authoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
